title: Nonzero Correlation Forces Finite Exponents
statement: Let $p,q\in[0,\infty]$, let $\rho\in\mathbb R$ be nonzero, and suppose $1\le p<q$ and $\rho^2(q-1)\le p-1$, with the inequality interpreted in the extended nonnegative reals. Then $1<p$ and $q$ is finite.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho^2(q-1)\le p-1$ in the extended nonnegative reals
